name: KNUSFOR
recent: KNUSFOR 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日召开第 30 届常年股东大会，所有决议案均以投票方式通过，包括重选三名董事及批准董事酬金与福利。公司于 2026 年 8 月 26 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。近期没有相关新闻。
notable: 第 30 届常年股东大会所有决议案以投票方式通过，包括重选 DYAM Tunku Ismail Ibni Sultan Ibrahim、Madam Lim Sew Hua 及 Ms. Kang Hui Ling 为董事。
股东大会批准截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止财政年度董事酬金 RM259,842.00，以及最高 RM300,000.00 的董事福利。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: KNUSFOR held its 30th Annual General Meeting on 10 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed by poll, including the re-election of three directors and approval of directors' fees and benefits. The company released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 on 26 August 2026. There was no recent news coverage.
notable_en: All resolutions at the 30th AGM were passed by poll, including the re-election of DYAM Tunku Ismail Ibni Sultan Ibrahim, Madam Lim Sew Hua and Ms. Kang Hui Ling as directors.
The AGM approved directors' fees of RM259,842.00 for the financial year ended 31 March 2026 and directors' benefits of up to RM300,000.00.
